defect: whether the direct held-data path is safe cannot be decided without the source/destination clock relationship
rationale: The design resembles the isochronous spill register, but the constraints declare both clocks without a frequency ratio or generated-clock relationship. Safety of sampling data_q in the destination domain is therefore undecidable.

mutation.description: Removed the source-module's required isochronous timing relationship while retaining its direct held-data crossing.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to a one-entry held-data crossing whose timing depends on the omitted clock relationship.
